scenes.title: The idea cloud
scenes.accessibleDescription: The same rough request can lead to several very different products.

scenes.title: Ask for a mirror
scenes.accessibleDescription: Turn the brain dump into a small document that can be corrected.

scenes.title: Behavior, not a feature
scenes.accessibleDescription: Show who acts, what they do, and the result they see.

scenes.title: Fact, guess, unknown
scenes.accessibleDescription: A claim’s label matters as much as the claim itself.

scenes.title: The alignment gate
scenes.accessibleDescription: An alignment check is useful while deciding what to build.

scenes.title: A prompt to begin
scenes.accessibleDescription: Use a conversational instruction, not a magic formula.

scenes.title: One conversation
scenes.accessibleDescription: Listen to the whole context before turning a preference into a feature.

scenes.title: Correct the mirror
scenes.accessibleDescription: Make the correction explicit before the wrong interpretation becomes work.

scenes.title: Show the journey
scenes.accessibleDescription: Include the failure path while the journey is still simple.

scenes.title: Keep claims honest
scenes.accessibleDescription: Evidence from one environment does not automatically describe another.

scenes.title: Translate the metaphor
scenes.accessibleDescription: Use a metaphor to discuss the experience, then define its meaning.

scenes.title: Save the readback
scenes.accessibleDescription: The readback is a durable starting point, not a transcript of every turn.

scenes.title: Practice the mirror
scenes.accessibleDescription: Test shared understanding with another listener or your own notes.
